channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: ADHD in women differs and carries unique health risks
item.description: ADHD was once seen as a childhood condition affecting boys. It now appears differently in girls, yet many still go undiagnosed.

item.title: Climate change threatens a childhood staple: summer break
item.description: Parents often sign kids up for outdoor summer activities, but extreme heat and wildfire smoke are making that increasingly difficult.

item.title: Children program robots to speak Indigenous languages
item.description: Many Native American languages are endangered. A 12-year-old in Michigan works with a mentor to preserve his language through robotics.

item.title: Displaced Lebanese use satellite images to check homes amid war
item.description: Some Lebanese displaced by Israel's invasion of southern Lebanon buy satellite images to see if their homes survived.
